overview_description.description:
Arylla is a company focused on making counterfeit goods a thing of the past.

Arylla uses invisible ink to help resellers of luxury goods verify authenticity. Luxury brands partner with Arylla to apply the ink during production in exchange for a share of the revenue. Arylla is the first platform that enables luxury brands to monetize the resale of their products while fighting to reduce the number of counterfeits being sold online.

about_short_description.short_description: Arylla is a company focused on making counterfeit goods a thing of the past.

product.name: Arylla Invisible Ink
product.description: A nanotechnology-based ink that is invisible and can be applied to various fashion products for authentication and traceability.

product.name: Low-touch Process Integration
product.description: A solution that integrates with label suppliers' existing processes, using a small inkjet station to print invisible ink on labels without additional production steps.

product.name: Seamless Software Integration
product.description: APIs that allow for easy integration of Arylla's scanning technology with popular messaging apps for enhanced customer experiences.

product.name: Many Label Applications
product.description: The invisible ink can be printed on a wide range of materials including labels, packaging, and trims.

product.name: Authentication
product.description: A feature that enables various departments to authenticate products, helping to prevent counterfeits and verify returns.

product.name: Traceability
product.description: Provides visibility across all channels, enabling tracking of products through each step of their lifecycle and offering real-time updates to customers.
